name: tile-unrevealed-summit
layout: horizontal strip, one slice per frame
y_offset_note: in source pixels; multiply by your draw scale (e.g. scale 4 -> 4 px per slice, draw each slice 4x at 1 px steps to fill gaps)
y_squash_note: optional: scale each rotated slice vertically by this before drawing (lower camera; 1.0 = classic top-down stack)
pivot_note: rotate every slice about its centre; the stack base sits at the pivot of slice 0
